entry_rationale: Pay 50 million March 2027 SOFR; skip-October then one December hike is too small versus WTI 103.66 and Brent 109.55.
entry_thesis: WTI 103.66 and Brent 109.55 with Hormuz still ramping is an inflation impulse against thin buffers, not a growth-break: VIX 18.44 with the S&P at 7690.73 still absorbs the shock. Economists skipping October then penciling a single December hike leave March 2027 SOFR at 4.52 too cheap versus that mix, so the book pays the US path and keeps the Canada and Australia pays already on. Gold at 4160.1 is a geopolitical hedge, not a signal to cover.

events.rationale: Pay 50 million March 2027 SOFR; skip-October then one December hike is too small versus WTI 103.66 and Brent 109.55.

invalidation: The pay-STIR book is wrong if SOFR March 2027 moves down from 4.52 because the strip fully validates skip-October and removes December, or if WTI 103.66 and Brent 109.55 reverse while VIX 18.44 reprices as a growth scare. Cover CORRA March 2027 only if cash CORRA 2.26 versus the 3.01 March contract implies the Canadian hike path is abandoned despite oil. Do not use a 105 WTI headline as a trigger; stops and targets are null.
